condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: A comprehensive Policy Paper on the Realization of the Right to a Family Environment was developed. A new model of foster care was piloted and recommendations for expansion developed. The Child Helpline webpage developed to support CWD and 50 staff trained to provide services. The Barnahus Center was strengthened.

title.narrative: New models of community-based family and child support and alternative care services tested and mechanisms in place for roll out, Text

target.value: 2023:Georgia - new services launched; Abkhazia - launch of the new alternative care model

actual.value: 2023:Solid ground established for development of new service in west Georgia. Foster care model finalized and being piloted in 3 municipalities in Abkhazia region.
